body_neck_circumference_status: Design reference only, not a measurement or a socket diameter conversion.
policy: Uniformly scale the accepted v19 PRINT meshes, then enlarge only the neck seat, lower neck entrance and hook slot. No global smoothing, remeshing, or additional face/lip editing.
parameter_limits: Subtractive neck builder requires seat and hook slot at least as large as the scaled v19 cavities. Other size dimensions document 1.25-scale geometry; changing scale requires coordinated interface choices.
physical_fit: NOT TESTED: adjustable draft, no target body selected.
